title: Minutes by Kind
prompt: Given the Material model in scope, implement `int total_minutes(const Material *ms, int n, Kind k)` summing minutes of records with kind k.

tests.name: mixed
tests.code:
Material ms[] = {{1, DOC, 5}, {2, VIDEO, 7}, {3, DOC, 2}};
CHECK_EQ(total_minutes(ms, 3, DOC), 7);

tests.name: video only
tests.code:
Material ms[] = {{1, VIDEO, 4}, {2, VIDEO, 6}};
CHECK_EQ(total_minutes(ms, 2, VIDEO), 10);
